doc: a tactic fails and parsing the next sentence of the proof overflows the stack: stock reports the tactic's error, and replay, which parses a candidate's sentences ahead, must report the same error
note: 1 MB stack, term 30000 levels deep. Under 1 MB the parser overflowed at about 900 levels in a dune release build merged on 466ade627a, and a term 3000 levels deep did not overflow in a make-world build of the branch (both 2026-10-31). 1 MB holds 30000 levels only if the parser takes less than 35 bytes of stack for each level. Fixture parse_overflow_control shows that this term overflows.
